editorialNotes: The figure of currently listed tours is a renderer variable {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}, not a static inventory count.
Wildlife theme on multi-country programs does not imply all wildlife occurs within Peru. Ecuador's Galapagos and Bolivian salt flats explicitly distinguished.
